items.title: Smart glasses are selling hot at National Vision, CEO ties it to the premium consumer
items.summary: Meta Platforms' (META) new Ray-Ban smart glasses are one of the fastest-selling products at eyeglass retailer National Vision (EYE). National Vision CEO Alex Wilkes comes on Market Domination to discuss the latest consumer buying trends around the new generation of wearable technology.

items.title: Could AMD's new Helios AI rack system push it to outperform Nvidia?
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) unveiled its latest AI infrastructure product, the Helios rackscale systems for data centers. Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley outlines AMD's latest raft of microprocessors and other products that aim to put it in direct competition with chip competitor Nvidia (NVDA). AMD is currently scheduled to report second quarter earnings on Tuesday, August 4, well ahead of Nvidia's earnings release expected out on Wednesday, August 26.

items.title: 2 Hidden Businesses to Watch as AI Keeps Heating Up
items.summary: Many investors feel like the AI trend has peaked, but the recent performances of Taiwan Semiconductor and Meta Platform suggest the AI build-out is still on.

items.title: Investors Zero In on Runaway Tech Spending, Putting Dent in AI Trade
items.summary: Concerns about artificial-intelligence spending shaved roughly $890 billion in market value from the Magnificent Seven on Thursday.

items.title: Europe just fined Google $1 billion, the day before Trump is expected to announce tariffs
items.summary: The European Commission fined Google the equivalent of about $1 billion Thursday for manipulating its search results to hurt competitors and blocking app developers from directing customers to cheaper deals outside its Play store.

items.title: Stock Market Today, July 23: Alphabet Slides 7% After Announcing 2026 Capex of Roughly $200 Billion
items.summary: Today, July 23, 2026, investors punished the search giant after it raised capital spending forecasts again, signaling aggressive AI investment ahead.

items.title: Why Americans Are Fighting the AI Data Center Boom
items.summary: Dozens of data center developers and utilities pledged with President Donald Trump that AI data centers won’t raise consumer electricity bills. The opposition won’t back down.
